lines.en: label beachwars6:
scene sanayasubeach1
: This is hard...
lines.zh: : 这好难……

lines.en: : Every time I try to write anything, all that comes out is a straight line or an arrow...
lines.zh: : 每次我试着写点什么,写出来的都只是一条直线,或者一个箭头……

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach2
: Maybe I should just give up for now...
lines.zh: : 也许我该现在就放弃……

lines.en: : There’s no way I can compete with someone like Otoha anyway...
lines.zh: : 反正我也赢不了 Otoha 那样的人……

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach3
: I guess Sensei {i}is{/i} kind of a creep, though...so maybe I do have a chance after all?...
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得 Sensei {i}算是{/i}有点变态吧……所以也许我其实还是有机会的?……

lines.en: : And...I know him better than she does, so...maybe there’s some way for me to take advantage of that?...
lines.zh: : 而且……我比她更了解他,所以……也许我有什么办法能利用这一点?……

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach4
: Ugh...
: But me winning would mean all {i}ten{/i} of us would have to stay at his house...
lines.zh: : 可要是我赢了,就意味着我们{i}十{/i}个人都得住进他的房子……

lines.en: : And if my confession is {i}too{/i} good, he might think I...
lines.zh: : 而且如果我的告白写得{i}太{/i}好,他可能会以为我……

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach5
: Who am I kidding?...
lines.zh: : 我骗谁呢?……

lines.en: : I’m the same as everyone else.
lines.zh: : 我和大家没什么两样。

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach6
: But it’s not like I can just say that...can I?...
lines.zh: : 可这种话我也不能就这么说出来……对吧?……

lines.en: : Would being honest even make for a good confession?...
lines.zh: : 说实话,真的能算是一份好告白吗?……

lines.en: : Or should I maybe...play to my strengths instead?...
lines.zh: : 还是说,我也许该……发挥自己的长处?……

lines.en: : I could, like...tug on his sleeve?...
lines.zh: : 我可以、比如说……拽拽他的袖子?……

lines.en: : And take him...somewhere private...
lines.zh: : 然后把他带到……没人的地方……

lines.en: : Pause a little...longer than normal...when I’m talking to him...
lines.zh: : 跟他说话的时候……停顿得比平时……更久一点……

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach7
: He likes that...right?...
lines.zh: : 他喜欢那样……对吧?……

lines.en: : He likes...that side of me...
lines.zh: : 他喜欢……我那个样子……

lines.en: : And...staying that way would be...the easiest thing for...mnh...all of us...
lines.zh: : 而且……一直那样下去,对……嗯……我们所有人来说都是……最轻松的……

lines.en: : Hah......ah.......not again.....
scene sanayasubeach8
: Maybe...if we’re in private...he’ll...{i}haah...{/i}
lines.zh: : 也许……如果我们独处……他会……{i}哈啊{/i}……

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach9
: Maybe...ahh...where...no one can see us...I can...make him realize...just how much I...
lines.zh: : 也许……啊……在……没人看得见的地方……我能……让他明白……我有多么……

lines.en: : How much I’m...just like...everyone else...
lines.zh: : 我有多么……和……其他人一样……

lines.en: : But you’re not.
lines.zh: 可你并不一样。

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach10
: Aah! Hah! Wha! Huh?! How...
lines.zh: : 啊!哈!什么?!怎么……

lines.en: : How...how much of that did you hear?! And...and why are you here?! I’m...I’m supposed to...be alone...
lines.zh: : 你……你听到多少?!还有……你为什么在这儿?!我……我应该……一个人的……

lines.en: : Why is it you think you’re the same as everyone else?
lines.zh: : 你为什么觉得自己和大家一样?

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach11
: That is...the actual...last thing I want to talk to you about...
lines.zh: : 那……是我最最……不想跟你谈的事……

lines.en: : If there is something that pains you, I can not make it go away. But with His guidance, I may be able to guide {i}you{/i} as well.
lines.zh: : 若有什么让{i}你{/i}痛苦,我无法让它消失。但在祂的指引下,我也许同样能为你指引方向。

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach12
: Um...with all...due respect, Yasu...I don’t think you’ll be...much help when...it comes to writing...a confession...
lines.zh: : 嗯……恕我……直言,Yasu……我不觉得你在……写告白这件事上……能帮上……多少忙……

lines.en: : I confess every single day. To every unwanted urge and every unwelcome thought. It is you who knows next to nothing about the act of confessing.
lines.zh: : 我每天都在告解。向每一个不想要的冲动、每一个不受欢迎的念头告解。对告白这件事一无所知的,反而是你。

lines.en: : Is {i}that{/i} why you see yourself the same as the others? Is it because none of you understand?
lines.zh: : {i}这{/i}就是你觉得自己和别人一样的原因吗?因为你们谁都不明白?

lines.en: : That is...definitely not what...
lines.zh: : 那……绝对不是……

lines.en: : Then what is it?
lines.zh: : 那是什么?

lines.en: : As His child, I am prepared to accept your truth- even if that truth is hard to swallow. For I know that it is but a single bump on a single road. And there are much greater things to fear than what ails {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 作为祂的孩子,我已准备好接受你的真相——哪怕那真相难以下咽。因为我知道,那不过是漫长道路上的一个小坎。而比起{i}你{/i}所困扰的事情,还有更重大的事物值得敬畏。

lines.en: : All I meant was...we’re all...chasing after...the same thing...
lines.zh: : 我的意思只是……我们所有人……都在追逐……同一样东西……

lines.en: : And I...want what...everyone else has...
lines.zh: : 而我……想要……别人都有的东西……

lines.en: : Then that is your confession.
lines.zh: : 那这就是你的告白。

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach13
: No, it...I think it has to be longer than that...
lines.zh: : 不,它……我觉得得比那更长才行……

lines.en: : It’s for...It’s for the competition...
lines.zh: : 这是为了……这是为了比赛……

lines.en: scene noonsky
: Oh!
: I believe I may have misunderstood you. I was under the impression you were in need of shepherding as well.
lines.zh: : 我想我是误会你了。我还以为你也需要有人指引。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize this confession was for the teacher.
lines.zh: : 我不知道这份告白是写给老师的。

lines.en: : Hahah...hah...yeah...that’s...
lines.zh: : 哈哈……哈……是啊……那个……

lines.en: : I feel like that’s...what most people would assume when...talking about...making a confession...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……大多数人谈起……告白的时候……都会这么想吧……

lines.en: : Then it makes sense that I didn’t understand — for I am no person at all.
lines.zh: : 那我听不懂也就不奇怪了——因为我根本就不是人。

lines.en: : Would you like to know what I am, Sana?
lines.zh: : 你想知道我是什么吗,Sana?

lines.en: : Um...uhh...
scene sanayasubeach14
: I’m special.
lines.zh: : 我很特别。

lines.en: : But...wouldn’t that...make you...still a person?...
lines.zh: : 可那不是……还是让你……算是个人吗?……

lines.en: : I’m not sure.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。

lines.en: : If I am a person, why is it that I am able to see things no one else does?
lines.zh: : 如果我是人,为什么我能看见别人看不见的东西?

lines.en: : Why am I able to pick words out of the wind and hold God inside of my heart?
lines.zh: : 为什么我能从风里挑出词句,又把上帝安放在我的心里?

lines.en: : I think...being a person just...means...you’re a human...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……所谓人,就只是……说你是个人类……

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach15
: Human...
lines.zh: : 人类……

lines.en: : I wonder if that word describes me at all.
lines.zh: : 我怀疑这个词到底能不能形容我。

lines.en: : I see myself as one who walks {i}among{/i} humans, but is something different. An insect, perhaps. And some days, I feel as if I’m nothing at all.
lines.zh: : 我觉得自己是在人类{i}之间{/i}行走的某种不同的存在。也许是只昆虫。有些日子,我又觉得自己什么都算不上。

lines.en: : But that is okay, for I have emptied out every ounce of myself to make room for His message that will one day save us all.
lines.zh: : 但那没关系,因为我已把自己掏得一干二净,好为祂有朝一日会拯救我们所有人的讯息腾出位置。

lines.en: : Or at least those of us who are smart enough to believe.
lines.zh: : 至少留给那些聪明到愿意相信的人。

lines.en: : I...think you’re a human, Yasu...
lines.zh: : 我……觉得你是人类啊,Yasu……

lines.en: : Unless...you’re actually a...shapeshifter or...something like that...
lines.zh: : 除非……你其实是……变形怪之类的……

lines.en: : Touka told me the same thing.
lines.zh: : Touka 也这么跟我说过。

lines.en: : I have been worrying her quite a bit lately. And I hate myself for becoming such a nuisance, but I keep making silly mistakes that even He does not look favorably upon.
lines.zh: : 最近我让她操了不少心。我恨自己变成这样一副累赘,可我还是不断犯下连祂都不悦的愚蠢错误。

lines.en: : If I am the same as the rest of you, why am I the only one who wants something different?
lines.zh: : 如果我和你们其他人一样,为什么只有我想要的东西不一样?

lines.en: : Why am I the only one who can not grasp the concept of being a normal girl? Or even understand what “normal” is?
lines.zh: : 为什么只有我抓不住做一个普通女孩的概念?甚至不明白『普通』是什么?

lines.en: : For me, all that exists is God.
lines.zh: : 对我来说,存在的一切只有上帝。

lines.en: : But maybe that’s because He is all that’s ever existed for me in the first place.
lines.zh: : 但也许那是因为,从一开始,祂就是唯一存在于我生命里的东西。

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach16
: I hope saying that was not a sin. And if it was, forgive me Father. You may take whatever you please from me in exchange for your holy pardon.
lines.zh: : 我希望说这些不算犯罪。若是,请宽恕我,天父。您可以从我身上取走任何您想要的东西,来换您神圣的赦免。

lines.en: : What do you mean that...God is...the only thing that’s ever existed?...
lines.zh: : 你说的……上帝是……唯一存在过的东西……是什么意思?……

lines.en: : Didn’t you...have...family or?...
lines.zh: : 你难道没有……家人或者?……

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach17

lines.zh: : 没有……

lines.en: : I have no mother...nor father. Nor anyone else...
lines.zh: : 我没有母亲……也没有父亲。别的人也没有……

lines.en: : But I do not need such relationships when they would be nothing but obstacles between the truth and me.
lines.zh: : 但我不需要这样的关系,它们只会成为横在我和真理之间的障碍。

lines.en: : If I am to assist in ushering in a new age of prosperity, where all who have avoided ruin look up to Him as the one true creator and follow His doctrines as the laws that guide the land, I {i}need{/i} no family.
lines.zh: : 我要协助迎来一个繁荣的新时代,让所有躲过毁灭的人都仰望祂,把祂当作唯一真正的造物主,并遵循祂的教义,以此为治理这片土地的法度——为此,我不{i}需要{/i}家人。

lines.en: : But even if I did-
lines.zh: : 但即使我需要——

lines.en: : There is not one out there who would want me.
lines.zh: : 这世上也没有一个会要我的人。

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach18
: That’s not true, Yasu...I’m sure that...there’s at least...{i}someone{/i} who...
lines.zh: : 不是那样的,Yasu……我相信……至少……会有{i}某个人{/i}……

lines.en: : I am not human. Therefore, there is no family in which I’d possibly fit.
lines.zh: : 我不是人类。所以,没有任何家庭是我可能融入的。

lines.en: : A more adequate description would be that I’m a monster.
lines.zh: : 更贴切的形容是:我是个怪物。

lines.en: : And that my inclusion anywhere other than where I am meant to be would only serve to destroy those who lived there first.
lines.zh: : 而把我放进任何不属于我的地方,只会毁掉原本住在那里的人。

lines.en: : Did...your god...tell you that?...
lines.zh: : 是你的……上帝……这么告诉你的吗?……

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : Everyone else did.
lines.zh: : 是其他所有人告诉我的。

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach19
: For as long as I can remember, I have been more than just myself.
lines.zh: : 从我记事起,我就不只是我自己。

lines.en: : There are worlds on top of this one that only I can see, but there is no one else who believes in them.
lines.zh: : 在这个世界之上,还叠着只有我能看见的世界,却没有第二个人相信它们存在。

lines.en: : And while I remain dedicated to finding those who can, I haven’t had very good luck so far.
lines.zh: : 虽然我始终致力于寻找那些会相信的人,但到目前为止运气都不太好。

lines.en: : But that is my plight. It is part of my test. And I must face this harsh adversity because it will bring me one step closer to salvation after all the pain has come and gone.
lines.zh: : 但那是我的苦路。是我考验的一部分。我必须面对这严酷的逆境,因为等所有痛苦来了又走之后,它会让我离救赎更近一步。

lines.en: : This world is filled with so many good things...so why is it that people turn away in fear when I share them?
lines.zh: : 这世上充满了那么多美好的事物……可为什么当我把它们分享出去时,人们却恐惧地转过身去?

lines.en: : Why should we ignore the other worlds when ours lacks so much of the information we need to understand why we’re here to begin with?
lines.zh: : 我们的世界缺少了那么多我们理解自身存在所需的信息,我们凭什么忽视那些其他的世界?

lines.en: : And why do we simply accept that the things taken away from us are gone forever when they’re always right behind us?
lines.zh: : 为什么我们只是默默接受,从我们身上被夺走的东西就永远消失了,而它们其实一直就在我们身后?

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach20
: The...
: The first time...and you might not remember it...but the first time we...talked, you...
lines.zh: : 第一次……你可能不记得了……但我们第一次……说话的时候,你……

lines.en: : You mentioned...something about...someone else...that...that was...um...
lines.zh: : 你提到过……什么关于……另一个人……那个……那个是……嗯……

lines.en: : He’s here now too.
lines.zh: : 他现在也在这里。

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach21
: Wh...who is it, though?! Who...do you see?!
lines.zh: : 谁……他是谁?!你……你看见了谁?!

lines.en: : I’m sorry if I didn’t explain things well as I’m not very smart, but when I say that I can {i}see{/i} things, it is mostly a figure of speech.
lines.zh: : 如果我没有解释清楚,我很抱歉,毕竟我不太聪明;但当我说我『{i}看得见{/i}』东西的时候,那多半只是个比喻。

lines.en: : It is more like knowing.
lines.zh: : 更像是『知道』。

lines.en: : I can sense the existence of what was once here and compare it with what is {i}still{/i} on other planes, but it is not as if I can reach out and touch any of it.
lines.zh: : 我能感知曾经存在于此的事物,并把它和其他层面上{i}依旧{/i}存在的事物作比较,但我并不能伸手去触碰其中任何一样。

lines.en: : E...Either way...do you...have any idea...who it is?...Can you talk to them?...
lines.zh: : 不……不管怎样……你……知不知道……那个人是谁?……你能和他们说话吗?……

lines.en: : Would it hurt you if I said I could?
lines.zh: : 如果我说我能,你会难受吗?

lines.en: : No! I...I want you to...be able to...
lines.zh: : 不会!我……我希望你能……做到……

lines.en: : Would you call me a monster if I reached out on your behalf...and the person you miss the most had me deliver a message you didn’t want to hear?
lines.zh: : 如果我替你伸出手,而你最想念的那个人让我带去一句你不想听到的话——你会叫我怪物吗?

lines.en: : No! I...I wouldn’t even think of that! There’s just...
lines.zh: : 不会!我……我根本不会往那方面想!只是……

lines.en: : I lost someone...really important to me...a few years ago and...I still...haven’t really...
lines.zh: : 几年前……我失去了一个……对我非常重要的人……而我到现在……还是没能真正……

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach22
: Why not talk to him yourself?
lines.zh: : 为什么不自己和他说话?

lines.en: : I...I don’t know how...
lines.zh: : 我……我不知道怎么……

lines.en: : I could show you a million times over and you’d still say the same thing.
lines.zh: : 就算我示范一百万遍,你还是会这么说。

lines.en: : It is not that you don’t know how. It is that you are opposed to learning.
lines.zh: : 并不是你不知道怎么做。而是你抗拒去学。

lines.en: : And so you will remain in blissful ignorance...because you and the one who came before you could not find it in yourselves to {i}believe.{/i}
lines.zh: : 所以你会一直待在幸福的无知里……因为你,还有在你之前的那个人,都没能让自己去{i}相信{/i}。

lines.en: : Yasu...I...don’t really understand what...
lines.zh: : Yasu……我……不太明白你说的……

lines.en: : He watches you when you do it.
lines.zh: : 你做那件事的时候,他在看着你。

lines.en: : Do...what? What...is he watching me do?...
lines.zh: : 做……什么?他在看着我做什么?……

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach23
: {i}Indulge.{/i}
: It can be lonely on the other side.
lines.zh: : 在另一边,是会寂寞的。

lines.en: : He enjoys the {i}entertainment.{/i}
lines.zh: : 他喜欢这份{i}消遣{/i}。

lines.en: : You’re a dirty...{i}dirty{/i} girl.
lines.zh: : 你是个下流……{i}下流{/i}的女孩。

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach24
: I’m...what?
lines.zh: : 我……什么?

lines.en: : You’re so lucky...being free enough to pleasure yourself without understanding the consequences.
lines.zh: : 你真幸运……自由到可以不用明白后果就取悦自己。

lines.en: : And so frequently as well. You’re going to go blind.
lines.zh: : 而且还那么频繁。你会瞎掉的。

lines.en: : It is what you wanted when I arrived.
lines.zh: : 我来的时候,你想要的正是这个。

lines.en: : It is what lured me here.
lines.zh: : 是它把我引来的。

lines.en: : I can trace the scent of pheromones from worlds away, and you are so pathetically pungent that it makes me want to {i}puke.{/i}
lines.zh: : 相隔好几个世界我都能循着信息素的气味追踪过来,而你身上那股味儿刺鼻得让我想{i}吐{/i}。

lines.en: : You want it right now...don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你现在就想要……对吧?

lines.en: : You want someone to pull you into the forest and {b}POP{/b} your fucking cherry before tossing you to the side and leaving you to rot.
lines.zh: : 你想要有人把你拖进林子里、{b}啪{/b}地捅破你他妈的处,然后把你往边上一丢,任你腐烂。

lines.en: : What would you say if I told you I’ve found the perfect person for that job?
lines.zh: : 如果我告诉你,我找到了最适合干这事的人,你会怎么说?

lines.en: : And that the one you miss the most would be happy to watch {i}that{/i} as well?...
lines.zh: : 而且你最想念的那个人,也会乐意在一旁{i}看着{/i}?……

lines.en: : Yasu! Where are- oh! Found you!
lines.zh: : Yasu!你在哪——哦!找到你了!

lines.en: : Masturbation is a sin, you horny bitch.
lines.zh: : 自慰是罪,你这发情的贱货。

lines.en: : If you want to win that stupid contest, all you have to do is spread your legs.
lines.zh: : 想赢那场蠢比赛,你只要把腿张开就行了。

lines.en: : We all know you want to anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正谁都知道你本来就想。

lines.en: : Yasu! Where have you been? I’ve been looking all over for you!
lines.zh: : Yasu!你跑哪儿去了?我到处在找你!

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach25
: I’m sorry for disappearing, Touka! I must have gotten lost again.
lines.zh: : 对不起我突然不见了,Touka!我一定又迷路了。

lines.en: : I told you to stay close to me at all times. I don’t want you wandering off and getting hurt.
lines.zh: : 我让你时刻都跟紧我的。我可不想你乱跑受伤。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Touka. It won’t happen again.
lines.zh: : 对不起,Touka。不会再发生了。

lines.en: : Well, it has to happen at least {i}one{/i} more time as your Dorm Wars contest is centered around that exact thing. But this time, it will be expected and I’ll be with you for at least half of the journey.
lines.zh: : 唉,至少还得再发生{i}一次{/i},因为你的宿舍战争比赛就是围绕着这个设计的。不过这一次是意料之中的,而且至少一半的路程我都会陪着你。

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach26
: Hooray! Competition!
lines.zh: : 万岁!比赛!

lines.en: : Yes. Hooray. Now, please follow me and-
lines.zh: : 是是是。万岁。现在,请跟我来,然后——

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach27
: Wha- Yasu?! What part of “stay near me” do you not understand?! Cease this sudden defiance at once!
lines.zh: : 什——Yasu?!『待在我身边』这几个字你到底哪里听不懂?!立刻停止这突如其来的违抗!

lines.en: : I found a shell! Look, Touka!
lines.zh: : 我找到一个贝壳!你看,Touka!

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach28
: Ugh. That girl. I swear I-
lines.zh: : 唉。那个女孩。我发誓我——

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach29
: Sana?...What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : Sana?……你怎么了?

lines.en: : Did something happen?
lines.zh: : 发生什么事了吗?

lines.en: : If Yasu said something strange to you, I’d like to apologize on her behalf. I’m sure you may have noticed by now, but she is not exactly-
lines.zh: : 如果 Yasu 对你说了什么奇怪的话,我代她向你道歉。我想你大概已经注意到了,她并不是——

lines.en: : Keep...her...away...from me...
lines.zh: : 让……她……离我……远点……

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach30
: What?...
scene sanayasubeach31
: Wait! Sana! Please understand! My family’s medical staff is working around the clock to ensure that Yasu is properly-
lines.zh: : 等等!Sana!请理解!我家的医疗团队正在夜以继日地工作,以确保 Yasu 得到妥善的——

lines.en: : Touka, look! Another shell!
lines.zh: : Touka,你看!又一个贝壳!

lines.en: scene sanayasubeach32
: Aaaaaaaah! Why won’t anyone let me talk?!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊!为什么没人让我把话说完?!
